messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Zolu Industries participated in Nolu Accord Talks

response: According to the filing, Zolu Industries participated in Nolu Accord Talks as a full signatory delegation. The records say its name appears on the attendance roll for every session.
